# MatchMyStyle

> See a look you love? Shop it in your size. MatchMyStyle analyzes outfit photos and finds real products to match, in your size, at budget, mid-range and vintage price points.

MatchMyStyle is an AI fashion styling and shopping-discovery site, not a retailer. Upload a photo or paste an image link, and it identifies each piece, names the look's aesthetic and finds matching products from real stores. A shopping concierge builds full looks from a description, an occasion or an aesthetic.

## Pages

- [Home](https://matchmystyle.app/): What MatchMyStyle does and how it works.
- [Outfit Analyzer](https://matchmystyle.app/analyzer): Upload an outfit photo to identify every piece and shop it in your size.
- [Shopping Concierge](https://matchmystyle.app/concierge): Describe what you're dressing for and get a full look built from real products.

## How it works

1. Add an outfit photo or image link, or describe what you want to the concierge.
2. MatchMyStyle identifies each piece (coat, top, trousers, shoes, bag, jewelry) and searches live store catalogs for matches in your size. Clothing sizes apply to clothing only; jewelry, bags and shoes are matched without one.
3. The look is put together with a budget, mid-range and luxury option for each piece, plus vintage searches on Poshmark, Depop, ThredUp and Vestiaire. Any piece can be swapped in place.

Free to use, no account needed. Prices and stock come from the stores at the time of the search and can change. MatchMyStyle may earn a commission when people shop through its links; it never changes the price.

## Aesthetics

Looks are organized into NYC-inspired aesthetics:

- Brownstone Minimal: warm, quiet tailoring in a few good neutrals (camel coats, black knits, wide-leg denim, gold)
- Downtown Uniform: all black with edge (leather jackets, washed black denim, lug boots, silver)
- Off-Duty Muse: easy denim basics (white tanks, baggy jeans, chunky sneakers, ball caps)
- Gallery Hours: one bold color against quiet neutrals, sculptural shapes
- East Village Romantic: dark, moody romance (lace, velvet, dark florals, sheer layers)
- Upper West Prep: academic and put-together (plaid, cable knits, blazers, loafers)
- Midtown Power: sharp suiting with strong shoulders and '80s confidence
- Broadway Maximalist: prints, color clash and statement accessories
- Tribeca Archive: vintage designer pieces worn as everyday clothes
- Prospect Park Sport: athletic pieces styled for the street (track pants, retro sneakers)
- Nolita Soft: sweet and feminine (pink, bows, satin, ballet flats)
- Bushwick Experimental: avant-garde, asymmetric, deconstructed
